bagPolicy.summary: Snapdragon Stadium permits clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags and small clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Paid bag lockers are available outside on the east side.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The stadium lists Orange and Yellow general parking, accessible parking in the Green Lot and overflow in SDSU structures P3 and P4. Overflow parking is $3 per hour; event parking prices can differ.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The designated rideshare pickup and drop-off area is on Mission Village Drive north of Jacaranda Street.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Stadium food and beverage stands operate without cash; reverse ATMs are available near the southeast and northeast entrances. Offerings vary by event.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Assistive listening devices are available at Guest Services behind Sections 101, 114, 135 and 328; accessible parking is in the Green Lot.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Snapdragon Stadium does not allow re-entry after a guest leaves.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue has not published a general will-call pickup procedure in its A-Z visitor guide.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The A-Z guide describes entry screening and bag inspection but does not publish a universal concert door-opening time.
